name: Oligio X
summary: A Korean 6.78 MHz monopolar radiofrequency platform with contact cooling of the skin surface, used within RF treatment for mild to moderate facial laxity.
leadAnswer: Oligio X is a monopolar radiofrequency platform from Wontech, a South Korean manufacturer, used at Kaiteki within our radiofrequency treatment. It runs at 6.78 MHz through a disposable tip that cools the surface while heating the dermis, and the published studies on the Oligio platform it builds on focus on mild to moderate laxity of the lower face.

facts.value: Studied in skin types III to V
facts.label: Evidence base

sections.heading: What is Oligio X?
body: Oligio X is a monopolar radiofrequency (RF) device developed by Wontech in South Korea, and at Kaiteki it is one of the platforms used within our radiofrequency treatment. It belongs to the same energy category as other monopolar RF systems: current flows from a single treatment tip through the tissue, which lets the heat reach the dermis rather than staying near the surface. Oligio devices have US FDA 510(k) clearance, which is a regulatory clearance rather than an approval of any cosmetic outcome.

sections.heading: How Oligio X heats the skin from the inside
body: Oligio X delivers RF energy at 6.78 MHz through a disposable tip placed on the skin. As the current meets the natural resistance of the tissue, it is converted to heat in the dermis. That controlled warmth makes existing collagen contract slightly and then prompts a slower remodelling response over the following months, which is where any gradual firming comes from.

The tip cools the skin surface on contact while the heat builds beneath it, so the epidermis is protected and the dermis can reach a useful temperature. The device also monitors contact and tissue impedance through the tip, which helps the energy go in evenly from shot to shot. Energy level, the number of shots and the passes over each area are chosen by the treating doctor for your skin.

sections.heading: What the published Oligio studies looked at
body: Oligio X builds on the original Oligio, which has device-specific clinical data, not only general RF theory. A 2022 study in Dermatology and Therapy treated 30 Thai patients with skin types III to V and mild to moderate lower-face laxity with a single Oligio session, and blinded dermatologists graded progressive improvement at one, three and six months, with no serious adverse events reported. A 2024 Korean study of 20 women reported improvement in jawline and nasolabial sagging after one session that remained through 24 weeks.

These are small studies in carefully selected patients, and they describe mild to moderate laxity rather than marked sagging. They are useful for knowing what the device was tested on, not a prediction of what any one person will see.

sections.heading: Which concerns is Oligio X considered for?
body: Oligio X is mainly used on the face and upper neck for people with early to moderate loss of firmness who prefer a non-needling option with little downtime. It is not suitable for everyone, and a consultation determines whether it is appropriate for you.
list: Early jowling and a softening jawline
Mild to moderate laxity of the lower face
General loss of firmness and elasticity in the cheeks
Laxity of the upper neck, assessed individually

sections.heading: When Oligio X is not the right tool
body: A less defined jawline is not always a skin problem. Fat under the chin, volume loss, chin projection and bone structure can all blur the contour, and RF tightens skin rather than removing fat or replacing volume. Where those dominate, another treatment, or a combination, is usually the better plan. Marked sagging is generally beyond what any surface RF device can address.

Like other RF devices, Oligio X is avoided during pregnancy, with a pacemaker or other implanted electronic or metal device near the area, over active infection or inflamed skin, and with a history of keloid scarring. Tell the doctor about recent injectables, retinoids or peels, because they affect timing and settings.

sections.heading: What an Oligio X session feels like, and the recovery
body: The first visit is a consultation, not a treatment. If Oligio X is appropriate, the skin is cleansed, the areas are mapped, and the doctor works across them shot by shot, with the tip cooling each spot as it heats. Most people describe short bursts of warmth rather than pain; numbing cream can be applied beforehand where comfort is a concern, and settings can be adjusted during the session.

Mild redness or warmth is common and usually settles within hours, and most people go back to normal activities the same day. A course of about two to three RF sessions spaced four to six weeks apart is common, followed by maintenance, though your doctor sets the plan for your skin. Daily sun protection afterwards helps protect the collagen the treatment is building.

sections.heading: Can Oligio X burn or mark the skin?
body: Redness, warmth and mild swelling are the usual short-lived effects. Less commonly, RF can cause blistering, burns or a change in pigmentation, which is why cooling, contact monitoring and energy settings matter, and why the treatment is performed by a trained doctor who matches the settings to your skin.

faqs.q: Is Oligio X the same as Thermage?
faqs.a: No. Both are 6.78 MHz monopolar RF devices with surface cooling, so they sit in the same category, but they are separate devices from different manufacturers with their own tips, protocols and clinical histories. Oligio X is made by Wontech in South Korea. Your doctor chooses a platform for your skin rather than by brand.

faqs.q: How is Oligio X different from XERF at Kaiteki?
faqs.a: Both are surface monopolar RF platforms without needles. Oligio X runs at a single 6.78 MHz frequency and is delivered shot by shot through a cooled tip, while XERF combines two frequencies so energy can be biased towards shallower or deeper tissue. Which suits you is decided at consultation from your skin and the area being treated.

faqs.q: Does Oligio X help a double chin?
faqs.a: Only where loose skin is part of the problem. Oligio X tightens skin rather than removing fat, so if the fullness under the chin is mainly fat, a treatment aimed at fat is usually more appropriate. A doctor can tell you which you are looking at.

faqs.q: How long do Oligio X results last?
faqs.a: It varies with age, skin quality, sun exposure and lifestyle. Change develops over months as collagen remodels, and the published Oligio studies followed patients for up to six months. Maintenance sessions are usually part of the plan to help the effect hold.
